method: Independent native libext2fs read-only allocation-map scan; 16 MiB bounded reads of every free root-filesystem block. Uninitialized block groups and implicit reserved metadata are handled by libext2fs.
limits: Covers free blocks of the root ext4 filesystem. Allocated files, other partitions, and unallocated disk regions are covered by the separate whole-disk privacy scan.
This test is independent of the zeroing implementation and does not alter the disk.
